records.institution_name: Juntas Generales de Bizkaia / Bizkaiko Batzar Nagusiak

confirmed.institution_and_media_provenance: The official institutional homepage links mediateca.jjggbizkaia.eus; the 2 October launch notice designates the new media service and describes public access without subscription. Its prose spells the hostname mediateka; use the functioning mediateca host linked from institutional navigation.
confirmed.provider: The media-service credits identify Spica S.L./Seneca software; this software credit does not license the institution's recordings.
confirmed.live_observation: HTTP 200. Page advertises room-original, room-subtitled, translated-original and translated-subtitled channel labels with Emitiendo markers. No frames/audio were decoded; those markers alone do not verify active proceedings.

dated_proceedings.title: Comisión de Infraestructuras y Desarrollo Territorial
dated_proceedings.scope: Archive-list entry only; individual committee record not decoded.

confirmed.coverage: Institutional launch notice explicitly covers plenaries and committees, live and historical sessions. Recent media list contains both.
confirmed.languages: Media navigation offers Euskara/Castellano. Institutional live page offers original sound and simultaneous translation, and the media live page separates room/translated/caption variants. Exact audio languages and subtitle accuracy are untested.
confirmed.programme_information: Dated archive page exposes organ, date/time, duration, agenda, transcript tab and a PDF convocation. The launch notice explicitly describes video/audio downloads, AI-generated transcripts and supplementary agenda/convocation PDFs.
confirmed.schedule_observation: Official HTML lists Comisión de Transportes, Movilidad y Turismo on 27 October 2026 at 09:30 and Pleno de Control on 28 October at 09:30. The same extraction also includes a no-upcoming-emissions placeholder; a parser must distinguish visible entries from templates.

sampled_archive_playback.provenance: The official institutional homepage links the Mediateca, whose dated archive list links this recording.
sampled_archive_playback.browser_path: Browser plugin not available; used installed Playwright 1.64.0 Chromium and WebKit with a 1440 x 1000 viewport.
sampled_archive_playback.flow: Official institutional designation -> dated source-player page -> native muted play -> seek to 1200 seconds -> advancing decoded parliamentary footage.
sampled_archive_playback.interactions: The source page was loaded normally. The native HTML video was muted, play() was invoked, and its currentTime was set to 1200 seconds for a later sample. No media URL was extracted and no download button was used.
sampled_archive_playback.visual_observation: Inspected decoded frames show a presiding speaker at the chamber dais initially and a later speaker addressing the chamber from the lectern. The official page names the plenary and date, and its highlighted later speaker marker reads Gómez-Guadalupe García-Tejedor, Pablo. These are substantive proceedings, not a placeholder or holding slate.
limits: Muted playback confirms sampled video decoding/time advancement; sound intelligibility, actual spoken language, interpretation and lip sync were not evaluated.
No HTML text tracks were exposed in this sample; this does not prove the service lacks captions. Caption availability/accuracy is unresolved.
The source player rendered speaker-marker clock times beginning 03:30 while the session metadata states 09:30; timezone/display conversion needs verification before programme ingestion.
WebKit displayed a source-player banner describing an audio stream while decoded video frames and dimensions were present; that label does not establish audio verification.

Only two short positions of this one archive recording were sampled; committee decoding, full-recording continuity, live performance and external embed/direct-playback/rebroadcast rights remain unresolved.

copying_recording.conditions: Official 2 October notice explicitly offers these downloads without subscription. It does not settle independent live recording or all redistribution uses.

audiovisual_reuse.conditions: Notice explains that downloads support television, digital media, radio and podcasts; exact licence, editing, attribution and commercial-use conditions still need confirmation.

programme_data.conditions: Downloadable documents/transcripts are expressly offered; no specific data-republication licence or current machine-readable EPG feed confirmed. AI transcripts require editorial quality checks.
